## File: `references/languages/javascript.md`

### Detection signals — JavaScript/TypeScript (Data Protection)

Detection signals only. They cite no standard. Report findings against the element IDs listed (defined in
`../standards/`). Mongoose `toJSON`, Prisma `select` and framework serializer defaults aren't localized: judge explicit
code only, and add a `localized-standard-gap` note when a decision depends on a default.

| Signal (API, setting or pattern) | Look in | Indicates | Element(s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `res.json(user)` / `return await prisma.user.findMany()` with no `select`, or a Mongoose document without a `toJSON` transform hiding `password` | routes, controllers, resolvers | Over-exposure on output | BOP-03, BOP-01 |
| `localStorage.setItem('profile', JSON.stringify(user))`, personal data in `sessionStorage` or IndexedDB | front-end code | Personal data in client storage | HSP-01, HSP-02 |
| `` fetch(`/api/users?email=${email}`) ``, `router.navigate([...], { queryParams: { email } })`, `` `/users/${email}` `` | front-end and route code | Personal data in URLs | QSE-01 |
| `<input name="ssn">` or card inputs without `autocomplete="off"` | templates, components | Sensitive input autofill | HSP-03 |
| `Sentry.init` without `dataCollection` limits; `Sentry.setUser({ email })` | app bootstrap | Error tracker sends user data | TPS-04 |
| `gtag('config', …, { user_id: email })`, analytics `identify(email, {...})`, `openai.chat.completions.create` with whole user records | front-end, services | Personal data shared with third parties | GDPR-01 |
| `seed.ts`, `fixtures/*.json`, `__mocks__` with names, emails, card numbers | tests, seed scripts | Seed data (synthetic or real-looking) | SP122-06, RSV-01 |
